instruction: How to add a basic filter with ematch
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: basic match 'cmp(u16 at 2 layer ip eq 2048)' action drop

instruction: How to add a u32 filter with src/dst IP and port
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.0/24 match ip dport 80 0xffff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter with TCP flags
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match tcp flags 0x02 0xff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter with offset
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip sport 0 0xffff at 0 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter for ICMP type
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 1 0xff match u8 8 at 20 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a filter to set pkt mark for QoS
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.0.0.1 action skbedit mark 1

instruction: How to add a tc filter that mirrors traffic
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 action mirred egress mirror dev eth1

instruction: How to add a tc filter that redirects traffic
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 action mirred egress redirect dev eth1

instruction: How to set up a CBQ (Class Based Queueing) qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: cbq bandwidth 100mbit avpkt 1000 cell 8

instruction: How to add a CBQ class
output: tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 cbq bandwidth 100mbit rate 10mbit weight 1mbit allot 1514 prio 5 maxburst 20 avpkt 1000

instruction: How to add a HFSC (Hierarchical Fair Service Curve) qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: hfsc default 30

instruction: How to add an HFSC class
output: tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:10 hfsc sc mtu 1500 rate 10mbit ul mtu 1500 rate 10mbit

instruction: How to add a DSMARK qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: dsmark indices 64 default_index 1

instruction: How to set a DSMARK value
output: tc class change dev eth0 classid 1:1 dsmark mask 0xfc value 0x10

instruction: How to add a choke qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root choke limit 30000 min 5000 max 15000 probability 0.02 avpkt 1000 bandwidth 10mbit ecn

instruction: How to add a codel qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root codel limit 1000 target 5ms interval 100ms

instruction: How to add a pie qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root pie limit 1000 target 15ms tupdate 30ms alpha 2 beta 20

instruction: How to add a fq (Fair Queue) qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root fq limit 10000 flow_limit 100 quantum 3000

instruction: How to set the default qdisc for all interfaces
output: sysctl -w net.core.default_qdisc=fq_codel

instruction: How to check the current default qdisc
output: sysctl net.core.default_qdisc

instruction: How to show all tc qdisc parameters for eth0
output: tc -d qdisc show dev eth0

instruction: How to show all class traffic stats
output: tc -s class show dev eth0

instruction: How to reset tc statistics
output: tc -s -s qdisc show dev eth0

instruction: How to add a qdisc on a child interface
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0.100 root fq_codel

instruction: How to show tc qdisc for all interfaces
output: tc qdisc show
